about: Answer key for tests/eval_furigana_live.mjs. Built by tools/furigana-eval/build_gold.mjs; edit adjudications.json there, not this file. Holds kanji runs and readings only — the lyrics are fetched live from NetEase by song id and line timestamp. gold[0] is the reading sung; any other entries are also correct. kuromoji is the dictionary baseline's reading (null: none).

categories.dictionary: the reading a dictionary gives the word out of context
categories.context: a word whose reading depends on the words around it
categories.rare: uncommon kanji or words a dictionary analyzer does not know
categories.sung: more than one reading is correct; the singer chose one
categories.gikun: a reading the lyricist assigned, not one any dictionary gives
categories.printed: a reading written into the lyrics themselves, as in 溢(こぼ)れた
